Operator ruling 2026-08-23: "Missing blank between OPEN rows and footer. But unnecessary blank after, at the bottom." T799 had removed BOTH blanks; only the lower one should have gone. Two changes, test-first (arms written and run RED against the pre-fix live file, GREEN after): (1) Restored the footer's leading newline (untracked/watch-fleet.sh footer printf) — the footer is a separator from the data, so the line directly above it is blank and the line above that is data; kept T799's other half (no trailing newline: the footer stays the terminal's last line, cursor hidden while watching, restored by cleanup on the q AND ^C/TERM/HUP paths). The reserve gained the +1 for the restored blank (base = 2k-1+2: k headings + (k-1) separators + blank-above-footer + footer). (2) Fixed the reserve/print off-by-one that was the second complaint: the old reserve charged a "(more)" row on nd/no > MIN_ROWS, but show() prints "(more)" on tot > slots — a section given enough slots to show every row was charged a line it never printed, and the frame came up a line short (the blank at the bottom). Measured at HEAD: FLEET_LINES=40 printed 39 of 40 (one (more) printed, two reserved). The split depends on the reserve and the reserve on the split, so the circularity is resolved explicitly: split with no "(more)" reserved, add one "(more)" row per section the split actually truncates, re-settle until stable (cannot diverge: each added "(more)" costs a slot, truncation only spreads — at most 2 passes, DONE/OPEN); every slot is handed to a section that can use it (a loop, not one pass per section: a single pass can leave the first section over-allocated again) and each section is floored at MIN_ROWS but never above what it holds. The real deliverable is the invariant, now pinned by arm N: printed lines == ROWS exactly (interactive; one-shot = FLEET_LINES - 2, the interactive-only blank+footer) at three heights (24/40/60) x two section mixes (all five sections present; only DONE+OPEN), plus the "(more)" accounting: a truncated section prints exactly one "(more)", a section given enough slots prints none, and neither case changes the total line count (18 rows shown vs 17 rows + "(more: 23)" is the same 18 lines). MAX_ROWS raised 20 -> 200: with exact fill the 50/50 split already bounds each flexible section at ~ROWS/2, so the cap only guards a pathological store — a 20 cap left terminals taller than ~45 rows unfilled, the same blank-at-the-bottom family (arm N was red at height 60 at HEAD exactly for this: 52/58 lines). Arm K re-pinned: 40-row terminal, 20 DONE + 20 OPEN now shows 16+17=33 rows in a 38-line one-shot frame (interactive = 40 exactly, blank above the footer) vs T799's 34 rows / 39 lines and T739's 32 / 37 — the restored blank took the row. Operator's exact measured scenario re-verified post-fix (407 DONE + 17 OPEN at FLEET_LINES=40): exactly one (more) line printed, DONE truncated, OPEN showing all 17 with no phantom reserve, frame fills exactly with the blank above the footer.
